column1: # GameScreen batch: 47 real methods + 39 javac-generated accessors + 4 enum switch maps.
# Real methods named from a code-explorer evidence pass: lifecycle overrides driven by
# listeners (commandStop/Repair/Patrol/Group/Ungroup), camera helpers, sprite and UV
# batching, HUD hit-testing, AI debug drawing, and the fog/exploration geometry builders.
# The static accessors are compiler bridges for the listener classes; each was named after
# the field it exposes, and the audio ones were derived from their load sites in show()
# (e.g. D returns W = audio_constructing.wav, s returns ap = audio_income.wav).
# Nine rows stay blank on purpose: field ae (float) plus bK/bM/X (long), their setters, the
# UnitList field v, and the j()/k() switch maps whose enum types were not read.
